DesignWork.title: "Colecta" 2022 and 2023 campaign
description: Graphic production development for Coaniquem's 'Colecta' campaign over the course of two years.

Coaniquem is a private non-profit institution, whose main objectives are to rehabilitate children and teenagers with burns and other scars free of charge, being "Colecta" the most important source of income for its financing.

DesignWork.title: Un Hombre de Verdad - Fanzines
description: Fanzine that compiles the testimonies of 246 Chilean men who consider themselves affected by the hegemonic model of masculinity.
For this project, the research work, the conceptual illustrations, and the binding of the fanzine in multiple formats were carried out.

DesignWork.title: Coaniquem BCF 2022-2023
description: Graphic and informational content design for Coaniquem BCF's social networks.
Coaniquem BCF is a non-profit organization in the United States. Its mission is to support the work of Coaniquem based in Chile, with special emphasis on international programs.

DesignWork.title: 50th Anniversary of the Ilko Toaster
description: Advertising campaign to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the Ilko toaster. The project included a limited-edition toaster and a promotional video, celebrating its legacy as a beloved national product.

DesignWork.title: Paperman Short Film – Illustrated Alternative Posters
description: Fictitious and alternative posters for Disney Pixar’s short film Paperman. This self-initiated project resulted in two illustrated posters and is not affiliated with or commissioned by the creators of the film.

DesignWork.title: GRIK - Logo and Infographic Design
description: Logo and infographics for GRIK project (2018), including a bespoke typeface created from scratch.

DesignWork.title: Exploring the Minecraft Nether Update: A Visual Guide
description: Infographic designed to quickly and engagingly highlight the features and changes in the Nether Minecraft Update.
This project was independently created and is not affiliated with or commissioned by the game’s developers.

DesignWork.title: Productivity & Ergonomics in Agriculture: RCP-19
description: RCP-19 is a horizontal trailed potato harvester designed to improve productivity and reduce physical strain during agricultural work.
The project was developed and presented to the Foundation for Agricultural Innovation (FIA) in Chile in 2019. It was later patented and featured in El Mercurio’s innovation column.

DesignWork.title: FullFace Mask Initiative: COVID-19 PPE
description: Communication materials for "FullFace Mask" Initiative (2020), a collaborative project between Fundación REBLUM, Decathlon, and Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile. The initiative repurposed Decathlon’s diving mask into a FullFace protective mask to help meet the urgent need for PPE among healthcare workers during the COVID-19 pandemic. Over 600 units were distributed.
The campaign included the production of a training video, a usage guide infographic, and social media content to support the safe and effective use of the masks.

DesignWork.title: Virutex - Exploratory Product Sketches
description: Product sketches developed as part of an early design phase in a broader collaboration with the brand.

DesignWork.title: Ril Editores - Cover Design
description: This cover combines visual elements and typography, achieving the incorporation of initials from philosopher Richard Rorty as the main design.

DesignWork.title: Finis Terrae's Medical School
description: Development of six educational materials for students, balancing informative content with friendly and accessible design.

DesignWork.title: Amazon Smile Donation Campaign
description: Design of social media content and explanatory videos for the collaboration between Coaniquem BCF and Amazon Smile. The goal was to promote the use of the platform and clearly explain the donation process.
Amazon, a global leader in e-commerce, launched Amazon Smile in 2013 — a service that donates 0.5% of eligible purchases to nonprofit organizations such as Coaniquem BCF.

DesignWork.title: Persia Motorsport – Branding & Stationery Design
description: This project showcases the development of comprehensive branding and stationery for Persia Motorsport, including logo design and visual identity elements that reflect the brand’s essence and values.

DesignWork.title: Clínica Elements - Rebranding
description: A comprehensive branding project for Clínica Elements, featuring logo redesign and the creation of visual identities that embody the brand's essence.

DesignWork.title: Amundsen Café - Branding and Digital Menu Solution
description: Brand assets for Amundsen Café, including logo design, custom signage, interior graphics, and an editable digital menu, allowing the owner to easily update prices and offerings.

DesignWork.title: Universidad de los Andes - Crisis Management and Well-Being Guidelines
description: This project focuses on the creation of printed materials offering clear instructions for students, staff, security guards, and faculty on how to respond in the event of a physical or mental health emergency. The initiative aims to foster a proactive approach to student well-being and provide critical support in times of crisis.

DesignWork.title: Printed Materials for Maternity Patients - Clínica Alemana
description: Visual update to soften and brighten maternity care communication.

DesignWork.title: Challengers South Korea 2025 - Universidad de los Andes
description: Key visual design for Challengers 2025, an entrepreneurship and innovation tournament that empowers young talent across the country to solve real-world challenges through creative and impactful solutions.
